propositions: Version lockstep must hold across pyproject.toml (1 occurrence of 0.10.1) and server.json (2 occurrences: top-level + packages[0]) for the release commit to pass authorization gates.
CHANGELOG.md must contain a curated [0.10.1] section with appropriate compare-link footers and release notes before merge.
Release commit must land on main via Gerrit with both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 gate votes, then be merged and fast-forwarded locally.
Built wheel and sdist artifacts must pass twine metadata validation (python -m build && twine check dist/*) before PyPI publication.
Version 0.10.1 must be published to PyPI and verified reachable via public API (pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/json), with matching GitHub Release tag v0.10.1 marked Latest at the released main commit SHA.
